news.titleEn: Trump says he is not keen on a deal with Iran as U.S. reportedly prepares for 'massive bombing'
news.conclusionEn: Trump said he no longer wants a deal with Iran as reports say the U.S. is weighing resumed large-scale strikes before the midterms.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称不想与伊朗达成协议，美国或恢复大规模空袭
news.whyEn: A return to full-scale war would threaten Gulf energy flows just as exports recover, raising oil, inflation and market risk worldwide.
news.whyZh: 战事重启将威胁海湾能源供应，推高油价与通胀，冲击全球市场
news.detailEn: Speaking at a rally in San Antonio, Trump said a deal 'isn't really something that I want to do,' even as envoy Steve Witkoff continues talks. NBC News and Axios reported his team has discussed resuming large-scale operations in the coming weeks, possibly including 'massive bombing' of Iranian energy, infrastructure and nuclear targets. Iran blamed mixed messaging from U.S. officials. Kpler data show Gulf crude exports have recovered to near pre-war levels of about 18.5 million barrels per day, so renewed strikes would put that recovery at risk.
news.detailZh: 特朗普在圣安东尼奥集会上表示「并不太想要这个协议」，但特使威特科夫仍在推进谈判。NBC和Axios报道称，其团队讨论在未来几周恢复大规模军事行动，目标可能包括伊朗能源、基础设施和核设施。伊朗方面指责美方立场前后矛盾。Kpler数据显示海湾原油出口已恢复至约每日1850万桶的战前水平，新一轮打击将危及这一恢复。

news.titleEn: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
news.conclusionEn: September FOMC minutes show most Fed officials expect another rate hike by year-end, without signaling the timing.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储纪要：多数官员预计年底前再加息一次
news.whyEn: Another hike would lift borrowing costs for households, companies and governments and keep pressure on bond and stock valuations.
news.whyZh: 再次加息将推高全社会借贷成本，继续压制债市和股市估值
news.detailEn: Minutes from the meeting that delivered a Sept. 16 hike said most participants saw another increase as likely appropriate by year-end, as inflation has run above target for more than five years. Officials stressed decisions will depend on incoming data. Core PCE inflation came in at 3% for August, below expectations, which has reduced the odds of a move at the Oct. 28 meeting. The Dec. 9 meeting is now seen as the more likely window under Chair Kevin Warsh.
news.detailZh: 9月16日加息会议的纪要显示，由于通胀已连续五年多高于目标，多数官员认为年底前再加息一次可能是合适的。官员强调未来决策将取决于数据。8月核心PCE通胀为3%，低于预期，降低了10月28日会议加息的可能性。市场目前认为在主席沃什领导下，12月9日会议加息的概率更大。

news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield backs off from 24-year high after solid bond auction eases demand fears
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.35%, its highest since 2002, before easing after strong demand at a $39 billion auction.
news.conclusionZh: 美10年期国债收益率触及5.35%，创2002年以来新高
news.whyEn: The 10-year yield sets the price of mortgages and corporate debt globally; a 24-year high tightens financial conditions everywhere.
news.whyZh: 10年期美债是全球房贷和企业融资的定价锚，24年新高意味着金融环境全面收紧
news.detailEn: The 10-year yield has jumped about 60 basis points since late July as U.S. crude rose 20%, stoking inflation fears. Wednesday's auction drew strong foreign demand, with indirect bidders taking 80.3% versus a 72.4% average, though the 5.3% auction yield was still the highest since 2000. Selling pressure is spreading abroad, with French 10-year yields up 12 basis points. Treasury will also hold a doubled-size buyback of long bonds on Thursday.
news.detailZh: 自7月底以来，随着美国原油上涨20%引发通胀担忧，10年期收益率累计上升约60个基点。周三拍卖海外需求强劲，间接投标人认购80.3%，高于72.4%的平均水平，但5.3%的中标收益率仍为2000年以来最高。抛压也在向海外蔓延，法国10年期收益率上升12个基点。美财政部周四还将进行规模翻倍的长债回购。

news.titleEn: Stock futures move lower after S&P 500 retreats from record: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stock futures slipped after the S&P 500 retreated from a record, and Asian markets fell broadly, with Korea's Kospi down 2.62%.
news.conclusionZh: 标普500自纪录高位回落，亚太股市普跌
news.whyEn: Rising yields and Iran war risk are denting appetite for richly valued stocks, especially in AI-heavy Asian markets.
news.whyZh: 收益率攀升叠加伊朗战事风险，压制高估值股票，AI权重大的亚洲市场首当其冲
news.detailEn: Higher Treasury yields weighed on investor appetite, pushing U.S. futures lower early Thursday. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 1.42%, the Kospi dropped 2.62% and Australia's ASX 200 lost 0.77%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng and China's CSI 300 also declined more than 1%. Investors are now watching third-quarter earnings season and the Fed's next steps.
news.detailZh: 美债收益率走高削弱了投资者的风险偏好，美股期货周四早盘走低。亚洲方面，日经225指数下跌1.42%，韩国Kospi指数下跌2.62%，澳大利亚ASX 200下跌0.77%。香港恒生指数和中国沪深300也跌超1%。投资者接下来将关注第三季度财报季和美联储的下一步动作。

news.titleEn: Samsung forecasts record third-quarter profit of $80 billion as AI boom fuels chip demand
news.conclusionEn: Samsung guided Q3 operating profit to a record 107.4 trillion won ($80.2 billion), up 782% year on year, yet the stock dipped.
news.conclusionZh: 三星三季度营业利润预计达802亿美元，创历史新高
news.whyEn: It confirms the AI memory boom is still accelerating, but the muted share reaction shows how high market expectations have become.
news.whyZh: 证实AI存储需求仍在加速，但股价不涨说明市场预期已极高
news.detailEn: Samsung's preliminary operating profit topped 100 trillion won for the first time, with revenue of about 195 trillion won, up nearly 127%. Shares still fell 0.7% as the result fell short of some expectations. Analysts note AI agents consume far more memory than chatbots, and buyers are signing multiyear supply contracts that improve visibility. Full results with a divisional breakdown are due later this month.
news.detailZh: 三星初步营业利润首次突破100万亿韩元，营收约195万亿韩元，增长近127%。但由于未达部分市场预期，股价仍下跌0.7%。分析师指出，AI智能体消耗的内存远超聊天机器人，客户正签订多年期供货协议，提升了需求可见度。包含各业务明细的完整财报将于本月晚些时候发布。

news.titleEn: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level
news.conclusionEn: Trafigura chartered a supertanker from the U.S. Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, about ten times the pre-war rate.
news.conclusionZh: 美湾至中国超级油轮运费达7600万美元，为战前10倍
news.whyEn: Soaring freight adds roughly $38 a barrel to delivered oil, feeding energy inflation for importers like China.
news.whyZh: 运费每桶约增加38美元，推高中国等进口国的能源成本
news.detailEn: The tanker Alexandros is expected to load around Nov. 19, versus a normal $7 million to $10 million for the route. The war in the Gulf has created a tanker shortage because Middle East producers now use a shuttle system through the Strait of Hormuz, transferring cargoes to other ships in the Gulf of Oman. That reduces exposure to Iranian attacks but ties up many more vessels. High shipping costs could persist as long as the conflict does.
news.detailZh: 油轮Alexandros预计于11月19日左右装货，而该航线正常运费仅为700万至1000万美元。海湾战事导致油轮短缺，因为中东产油国现在采用接驳方式通过霍尔木兹海峡，再在阿曼湾转运到其他船上。这降低了遭伊朗袭击的风险，但占用了更多船只。只要冲突持续，高运费可能难以回落。

news.titleEn: France to release diesel reserves in a bid to calm student protests
news.conclusionEn: France will release 10 million barrels of strategic diesel reserves to cut pump prices as student protests and budget strains mount.
news.conclusionZh: 法国释放1000万桶柴油储备，以平息学生抗议
news.whyEn: Social unrest plus budget deadlock is pushing French bond yields to multi-decade highs, a risk for the eurozone.
news.whyZh: 社会动荡叠加预算僵局，法债收益率升至数十年高位，威胁欧元区稳定
news.detailEn: Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said the release, sold at cost, should lower diesel prices by 12 to 18 euro cents per litre. It follows a G7 agreement last week to release 100 million barrels of reserves. Hundreds of schools were closed during a nationwide 'black week' of student protests over education underfunding. France faces tough budget negotiations in the coming weeks, with bond markets watching closely.
news.detailZh: 总理勒科尔尼表示，储备将按成本价释放，预计可使柴油价格每升下降12至18欧分。此前G7上周同意释放1亿桶储备。因抗议教育经费不足，全国性「黑色一周」学生运动导致数百所学校关闭。法国未来几周将面临艰难的预算谈判，债券市场正密切关注。

news.titleEn: Apollo, banks in talks to finance SpaceX's $40 billion Nvidia GPU purchase
news.conclusionEn: Apollo and several banks are in talks to finance SpaceX's $40 billion Nvidia GPU purchase, likely using the chips as collateral.
news.conclusionZh: 阿波罗等洽谈为SpaceX购买400亿美元英伟达芯片融资
news.whyEn: It shows AI capex is increasingly debt-funded, with GPUs treated as loan collateral, raising stakes for credit markets.
news.whyZh: 显示AI投资越来越依赖举债、以GPU作抵押，信贷市场风险随之上升
news.detailEn: The deal would mainly tap the investment-grade bond market, which SpaceX used for a $25 billion raise after its June IPO. Since then, AI-related bonds have sold off and credit spreads have widened. Lenders currently assume high-end GPUs hold value for about seven years given the scarcity of compute. The Financial Times first reported the talks.
news.detailZh: 这笔交易将主要依托投资级债券市场，SpaceX在6月IPO后曾在该市场融资250亿美元。此后AI相关债券遭抛售，信用利差扩大。由于算力稀缺，贷款方目前假设高端GPU可保值约七年。该谈判最早由《金融时报》报道。

news.titleEn: CNBC Daily Open: The blame game — Brussels vs Beijing
news.conclusionEn: EU trade chief Maroš Šefčovič is in Beijing for tense talks over hybrid car exports and the widening EU-China trade surplus.
news.conclusionZh: 欧盟贸易专员赴京谈判，混动车出口与贸易逆差成焦点
news.whyEn: The outcome could shape tariffs on Chinese cars across Europe, including in the U.K., and affect global automakers.
news.whyZh: 谈判结果将影响欧洲乃至英国对中国汽车的关税，波及全球车企
news.detailEn: Europe has asked China to voluntarily curb hybrid car exports, a request Beijing has reportedly rejected. Germany and France have urged Brussels to develop a 'last-resort' trade tool to address imbalances. The EU's 'Made in Europe' proposals may also pressure the U.K. to match EU tariffs on Chinese EVs. The two days of talks will test whether a trade escalation can be avoided.
news.detailZh: 欧洲要求中国自愿减少混动汽车出口，据报道已遭北京拒绝。德法两国敦促布鲁塞尔制定「最后手段」贸易工具来应对失衡。欧盟的「欧洲制造」提案也可能迫使英国跟随对中国电动车加征关税。为期两天的谈判将检验双方能否避免贸易摩擦升级。

news.titleEn: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles off north coast of Qatar, UKMTO says
news.conclusionEn: A tanker was struck by several projectiles about 94 km north of Qatar, with casualties reported, UKMTO said.
news.conclusionZh: 一艘油轮在卡塔尔以北海域遭多枚炮弹击中，有人员伤亡
news.whyEn: Rising attacks on Gulf shipping threaten energy flows and keep freight and insurance costs high.
news.whyZh: 海湾航运袭击增多，威胁能源运输，推高运费和保险成本
news.detailEn: The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said the vessel was hit north of Madinat ash Shamal but did not give casualty numbers. The agency has reported a recent rise in attacks on ships in and around the Strait of Hormuz. The incident comes as Washington weighs resuming large-scale strikes on Iran. Further attacks could reverse the recent recovery in Gulf oil exports.
news.detailZh: 英国海上贸易行动办公室称，该船在卡塔尔北部舍马勒城以北海域被击中，但未公布伤亡人数。该机构称近期霍尔木兹海峡及周边船只遇袭事件增多。事件发生之际，华盛顿正考虑恢复对伊朗的大规模打击。进一步的袭击可能逆转海湾原油出口的近期恢复势头。

businessTips.explanationEn: The bullwhip effect describes how small changes in end-customer demand get amplified as orders move up a supply chain. Retailers over-order a bit, wholesalers pad that further, and manufacturers see wild swings. It leads to excess inventory in some periods and shortages in others. Sharing real demand data and shortening lead times are the main cures.
businessTips.explanationZh: 牛鞭效应指终端需求的小幅波动在供应链上游被层层放大。零售商多订一点，批发商再加一点，到了制造商那里就成了剧烈波动。结果是有时库存积压、有时严重缺货。共享真实需求数据、缩短交货周期是主要的解决办法。
businessTips.exampleEn: Today's tanker shortage is partly a bullwhip story: fears over Hormuz led traders to book ships early, pushing a Gulf Coast–China charter to $76 million. A business that panic-buys stock during a shortage often ends up with a glut when conditions normalize.
businessTips.exampleZh: 眼下的油轮短缺部分就是牛鞭效应：对霍尔木兹海峡的担忧让贸易商提前抢订船只，把一趟美湾至中国的租船费推到7600万美元。企业在短缺时恐慌囤货，往往在形势恢复后陷入库存过剩。

businessTips.explanationEn: Burn rate is how much cash a business spends each month beyond what it earns; runway is how many months it can survive at that pace (cash ÷ net burn). Tracking both forces founders to make decisions before money runs out, not after. Most advisors suggest keeping 12–18 months of runway when raising money is hard. For side businesses, it also tells you how long you can test an idea before it must pay for itself.
businessTips.explanationZh: 烧钱率是企业每月支出超过收入的现金数额；跑道是按此速度还能撑多少个月（现金÷月净消耗）。跟踪这两个数，能让创始人在钱花光之前而不是之后做决策。融资困难时，多数顾问建议保留12到18个月的跑道。对副业来说，它也告诉你在必须自负盈亏前还能试验多久。
businessTips.exampleEn: If your side project has $6,000 saved and loses $500 a month on ads and tools, you have 12 months of runway. Cutting one $200 tool extends it to 20 months, buying far more time to find paying customers.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果你的副业存了6000美元，每月在广告和工具上净亏500美元，跑道就是12个月。砍掉一个200美元的工具，跑道就能延长到20个月，为找到付费客户争取更多时间。

businessTips.explanationEn: When the U.S. Treasury sells debt, analysts judge demand by the bid-to-cover ratio (bids received vs. amount sold) and by who buys. Indirect bidders, often foreign central banks and funds, signal global appetite; a high dealer share means primary dealers were forced to absorb unwanted supply. A 'tail' occurs when the auction yield comes in above pre-sale market levels, a sign of weak demand. These details can move the entire bond market within minutes.
businessTips.explanationZh: 美国财政部发债时，分析师通过认购倍数（投标总额÷发行额）和买家构成判断需求。间接投标人通常是外国央行和基金，代表全球需求；一级交易商占比高则说明它们被迫接下了没人要的债券。若中标收益率高于发行前市场水平，称为「尾部」，是需求疲弱的信号。这些细节能在几分钟内影响整个债市。
businessTips.exampleEn: In Wednesday's $39 billion 10-year sale, indirect bidders took 80.3% and dealers only 2.5%, so the market read it as strong and yields eased from a 24-year high. Investors in bond funds can watch these results to gauge whether rate pressure is building or easing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 周三390亿美元10年期国债拍卖中，间接投标人认购80.3%，交易商仅2.5%，市场解读为需求强劲，收益率随之从24年高位回落。持有债券基金的投资者可以通过这些结果判断利率压力是在上升还是缓解。
